models.name: View
models.desc: A view: a layout of panes, each holding tabs.

fields.name: layout
fields.desc: Its panes as they split, each with its tabs and the one in front.

fields.name: activeTab
fields.desc: Its active tab: the one with the focus, in front of its pane.

models.name: Pane
models.desc: A pane: an area of a view's layout, holding tabs with one in front.

fields.name: tabs
fields.desc: Its tabs, in the order its strip shows them.

models.name: Request
models.desc: A request shown to the user.

fields.name: tool
fields.desc: The tool a permission is for.

fields.name: level
fields.desc: How much it matters: info, warn, error or debug (only kept).

fields.name: notification
fields.desc: What a notification does in the OS's notification centre.

tabMethods.name: read
tabMethods.desc: Text read from a tab: a terminal's as its screen shows it, one line a row.

source.description: `visible`: the screen as it is; `recent` (the default): the scrollback and the screen; `unwrapped`: those, with lines wrapped at the screen's width joined.

lines.description: The last this many lines that hold something: the screen's rows for `visible`, 200 otherwise (`pumi tab read`: 50).

ansi.description: The output as the program wrote it, its escape sequences kept.

tabMethods.name: input
tabMethods.desc: Text, a paste, or keys sent to a tab.

tabMethods.name: run
tabMethods.desc: A command pasted and entered as one write.

tabMethods.name: wait
tabMethods.desc: A tab waited on for output or exit.

tabMethods.name: report
tabMethods.desc: An OSC 7501 report sent by a tab.

tabMethods.name: attach
tabMethods.desc: A terminal stream attached to a tab.

events.name: tab.opened
events.desc: A tab opened: `block` is what it holds; `restored` when it opened from a saved state.

events.name: tab.closed
events.desc: A tab closed: `block` is what it held.

events.name: tab.changed
events.desc: A tab changed in the fields `keys` names (`title`, `cwd`, `block`, `place`, `size`, `exitCode`, `options.<name>`, `traits.<trait>`); `patch` holds their new values.

events.name: tab.alerted
events.desc: A tab's program asked for attention: it rang the bell, or sent an OSC 9 or 777 notification (`message`).

events.name: request.opened
events.desc: A request was opened for the user (`request.open`): show it, and answer it with `request.close(id, {answer})`.

events.name: request.closed
events.desc: A request closed: `answered`, `closed` (unanswered, its tab closed, or a newer one of its group replaced it), `timeout` or `cancelled` (the channel that opened it went).

events.name: view.opened
events.desc: A view opened in a session.

events.name: view.changed
events.desc: A view changed in the fields `keys` names (`name`, `index`, `session`, `layout`, `activeTab`, `activePane`, `zoom`); `patch` holds their new values.

events.name: pane.opened
events.desc: A pane opened in a view: a tab split one off, or a view was made.

events.name: pane.closed
events.desc: A pane closed: its last tab went, or its view did.

events.name: pane.changed
events.desc: A pane changed in the fields `keys` names (`tabs`, `activeTab`); `patch` holds their new values.

events.name: session.changed
events.desc: A session changed in the fields `keys` names (`name`, `cwd`, `activeView`); `patch` holds their new values.

events.name: option.changed
events.desc: A global or plugin option changed; an object's options fire that object's `changed`.

events.name: app.changed
events.desc: A client's app came to the front or went behind (`isFocused`): one of its windows has the focus, or none has; `client` says whose.

events.name: registry.changed
events.desc: Entries of a registry kind (`registry.list`) were set, removed or changed: `names` are theirs.
